description: PubMed article metadata by PMID (NCBI E-utilities esummary, public, no key): title, journal, publication date, authors and DOI for up to 20 ids. Summary fields only, no abstracts. Takes about 10 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: search_datacite_metadata when you need DataCite DOI search: DOI, title, publication year, resource. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

pmids.description: One to 20 PubMed ids separated by commas, e.g. 12345678,31978945

name: search_pubmed_article_metadata
title: PubMed article metadata by PMID: title, journal
